Kai has one heart left. And the Hall Monitor is right behind him.
Last time, Kai asked if you'd respawned before. You said no.
Then every light in the school turns red. New quest. Survive the boss.
At the end of the hall, something tall steps out. No face. A glowing yellow sash.
Every time it says no running, Kai loses a heart.
And the hallway never ends. Same lockers. Same poster. Again.
Then you see it. A heart, floating above a locker. You jump. Three hearts!
But Kai trips. The Hall Monitor leans over him.

text: His last heart cracks. He starts to fade, and whispers... check your desk.
Then he's gone. Would you trust Kai? Comment yes or no.
